title: Datalist drawn by a canvas
blurb: The suggestions of <input list> drawn one <option> at a time by a canvas in a popover, as a list or as pills that rearrange while you type. Also the options of a range input's datalist drawn as tick labels.
question: The popup of <input list> can't be styled. Can the <datalist> element itself be put in a canvas and its options drawn as the suggestions?
result: Yes, once the input's list attribute is removed and the keyboard handling is rewritten. An option in a datalist renders only text, so rich suggestions aren't possible this way.
